title: 第5章 首战首杀首败第6章 进化凶兽首杀
slug: 圣殇天狱第1013章力战古神
content_zh:
夜空清月如勾，
大地漆黑如墨，
‘驾·驾’，
就连美姑一霸，石桑都赶来了，
他是玄武·徒境八级，武修入门级，
骑着膘肥体壮的黑马，在小镇乱冲乱撞，从来不管行人死活，
他上茅房也被扔过石块，对从来没有吃过亏的他来说，
这就是奇耻大辱，扭曲着鼻尖硕大的黑痣狂吼道；
‘找，给我找，敢在太岁头上动土，挖地三尺也要找出来挫骨扬灰。’
以北以南两颗极星忽明忽暗，
注定了是不平静的一晚，
那些老百姓都用抵门杠把家门抵的严严实实，唯恐引火烧身，
一群恶人把安静夜晚搞得乌烟瘴气，
他们一旦行动就不会空手而归，
一家院子房门被重击撞开，
他们就是穷凶极恶的匪徒，
直接冲入屋子，看见值钱的物品就开抢，
谁要反抗，便会招来拳打脚踢，
这里山高皇帝远，他们就是王法，
今晚，又是几个女子的噩梦，

正在遭受蹂躏。
~~~
云阳扔下石头便快速离开了这里，老僧只是为他筑体，开启了玄武·武巢，成为了武修，
目前才刚刚踏入徒境·二级，
在不远处半坡一株高大浓密的榕树隐藏了起来，
眼看着一群群匪徒欺压百姓，
剑眉皱的越来越紧，
身上的热血在开始沸腾，
青春之火点燃，在燃烧，
身体开始紧绷；
‘阿弥托佛，佛主，请赐予我力量，今天开始，美姑·银狐便开启伸张正义的第一战，荡尽人世间一切不平，战！’
‘驾·驾·驾，’
几匹快马和一群狗腿子寻着气息追到榕树下，
没有找到目标继续急匆匆的向山中追赶，
‘天昭神拳。’
云阳紧绷的身体突然在树枝用力一蹬，
如天神下凡，
玄武之气灌入拳中，轰向最后一个跑腿匪徒，
‘呯，’
夜空传来一声闷哼，

匪徒的头颅如西瓜一般爆裂，
content_en:
The clear moon is like a hook in the night sky,
The earth is as black as ink,
‘drive·drive’,
Even Meigu Yiba and Shi Sang came over.
He is at the eighth level of Xuanwu Disciple Realm, the entry level of martial arts.
He rides a fat black horse and rushes around the town, never caring about the life or death of pedestrians.
He also had stones thrown at him when he went to the latrine. For him who had never suffered a loss before,
This is a great shame and humiliation, he twisted the huge black mole on the tip of his nose and roared;
‘Look for it, look for it for me. If you dare to disturb Tai Sui’s head, you will dig three feet into the ground to find it, crush the bones and scatter the ashes. ’
The two pole stars to the north and south flicker brightly and dimly,
It was destined to be an uneventful night.
The common people used door-bars to barricade the doors of their homes tightly, fearing that they would be burned.
A group of evildoers turned the quiet night into a mess.
Once they take action, they will not come back empty-handed;
The door of a courtyard house was knocked open by a heavy blow.
They are extremely vicious gangsters,
Rush directly into the house and grab any valuable items you see.
Anyone who resists will be beaten and kicked.
The mountains are high here and the emperor is far away. They are the kings.
Tonight is another nightmare for several women,
is being ravaged.
~~~
Yunyang threw down the stone and left here quickly. The old monk just built a body for him, opened the Xuanwu Martial Nest, and became a martial artist.
I have just entered the Disciple Realm Level 2 now.
Not far away, a tall and dense banyan tree was hidden on the slope.
Seeing groups of gangsters oppressing the people,
Jian's eyebrows frowned more and more tightly,
The blood in my body begins to boil,
The fire of youth is lit and burning,
The body begins to tense;
'Amitabha, Lord Buddha, please give me strength. Starting today, Mei Gu Silver Fox will start the first battle to uphold justice and wipe out all injustices in the world. Fight! ’
‘Drive, drive, drive,’
Several fast horses and a group of dogs chased them under the banyan tree in search of breath.
Not finding the target, I continued to chase towards the mountains in a hurry.
‘Tianzhao Divine Fist. ’
Yunyang's tense body suddenly pushed hard on the branch,
Like gods descending to earth,
Xuanwu Qi poured into his fist and blasted towards the last errand gangster.
‘Bang,’
A muffled groan came from the night sky,
The gangster's head exploded like a watermelon,
